title: D5 Pro ST / All-terrain Electric Fat Bike
body_html:
The Himiway D5 Pro ST (Step-Thru) is a premium, all-terrain electric fat bike that seamlessly combines extreme durability and mid-drive power with the ultimate convenience of an accessible step-through frame. Designed for riders who want the rugged "tank-like" performance of a premium off-road bike without the hassle of swinging a leg over a high top tube, the D5 Pro ST makes all-terrain exploration accessible to everyone.

Whether you're cruising through hilly backroads, riding on sandy beaches, or running daily errands, the D5 Pro ST offers unparalleled stability and ease of use. Its foundation is an upgraded 6061 aerospace-grade aluminum step-through frame that is twice as thick as conventional e-bikes. This design provides massive structural integrity while making mounting and dismounting effortless—an absolute game-changer if you have limited mobility or are carrying a heavily loaded rear rack. Paired with puncture-resistant 26" x 4.0" Kenda K-shield fat tires, it delivers relentless grip and shock absorption across gravel, mud, and snow.

What truly sets the D5 Pro ST apart is its advanced 500W Torque-Sensing Mid-Motor (peaking at 1300W). Delivering a massive 130Nm of torque directly to the drivetrain, it flattens the steepest hills with ease. The intuitive torque sensor responds instantly to your pedaling effort, providing a smooth, natural riding experience that feels like a traditional bike but with superhuman strength—perfect for a balanced workout or injury recovery.

Despite its accessible design, the D5 Pro ST compromises nothing on heavy-duty utility. With a staggering 400 lb payload capacity and a seamlessly integrated 960Wh Samsung/LG battery, it provides up to 80 miles of anxiety-free range per charge. Premium components like a 9-speed Shimano drivetrain, fade-free hydraulic disc brakes, and an integrated auto-illuminating brake light ensure absolute safety and control wherever your journey takes you.

Best For:
  • Riders prioritizing effortless mounting and dismounting (older adults, injury recovery)
  • Parents and commuters hauling heavy rear cargo or child seats (no need to swing a leg over the back)
  • All-terrain explorers navigating snow, sand, gravel, and mud
  • Riders wanting the natural, workout-friendly pedaling feel of a mid-drive torque sensor
  • Anyone needing a robust 400 lb payload capacity on a highly accessible frame
Why Choose the D5 Pro ST?
  • Accessible Design: Easy-entry step-through frame without sacrificing extreme structural integrity
  • Mid-Drive Mastery: 500W Torque-Sensing Motor with a massive 130Nm of hill-crushing torque
  • Indestructible Build: Aerospace aluminum frame that is 2X thicker than standard e-bikes
  • Exceptional Range: Fully integrated 960Wh Samsung/LG battery yielding up to 80 miles
  • All-Terrain Grip: 26" x 4.0" Kenda K-shield fat tires for supreme traction in any weather
  • Heavy-Duty Hauling: 400 lb payload capacity for maximum utility, cargo, and passenger transport

The Himiway A7 is a premium full-suspension commuter e-bike designed for daily commuters, urban explorers, running errands, and riders seeking maximum comfort on paved streets and light trails. Built to redefine the city riding experience, it combines agile handling with cloud-like comfort, making every trip—from grocery runs to weekend park cruises—effortless and enjoyable.

Whether you're navigating uneven city streets, crossing railroad tracks, or weaving through neighborhood paths, the A7 delivers an incredibly smooth and stable ride. Its 120mm front and 90mm rear full-suspension system absorbs bumps and cracks before you feel them. Combined with an accessible step-thru frame for easy mounting, an extra-wide 220mm saddle, and a fully adjustable stem (0°-60°), you can dial in the perfect upright riding position to eliminate back, neck, and wrist strain.

Powered by a responsive hub motor and a high-capacity battery, the A7 delivers up to 70 miles of range on a single charge and features reliable hydraulic brakes for safe stopping in any weather. What truly sets the A7 apart is its versatile pedal-assist technology: riders can seamlessly switch between a Torque sensor (for a natural, workout-friendly feel on hills) and a Cadence sensor (for effortless, sweat-free cruising). It even features a Smart Auto Mode that automatically adjusts power output based on your terrain, so you never have to worry about changing gears.

With a robust 400 lb payload capacity and the highly versatile MIK Rear Rack system for instant accessory swapping (like panniers, baskets, or child seats), the A7 is the ultimate utility machine. Accommodating a wide range of rider heights (starting from 5'1"), the A7 proves that a highly capable, heavy-duty commuter bike can also be the most comfortable ride of your day.

Best For:

  • Daily city commuters and errand runners
  • Riders seeking an easy-to-mount step-thru frame
  • Older adults prioritizing joint, back, and hip comfort
  • Urban explorers and weekend park cruisers
  • Riders who need to carry groceries, gear, or child seats

Why Choose the A7?

  • Cloud-like comfort: Full suspension (120mm front, 90mm rear) and a 220mm wide padded saddle
  • Dual sensor technology: Switch instantly between Torque and Cadence modes mid-ride
  • Effortless riding: Smart Auto Mode adapts power to the terrain automatically without gear shifting
  • Impressive range: Up to 70 miles per charge for extended, anxiety-free city travel
  • Maximum utility: 400 lb payload capacity with a quick-swap MIK rear rack system
  • Tailored fit: 60-degree adjustable stem for a perfect, strain-free upright posture

Combined with an advanced four-bar linkage rear suspension and an 80mm adjustable front coil fork, it effortlessly absorbs violent bumps and jarring impacts, ensuring a smooth ride even on the most punishing trails.
